edits.new: These four criteria are new for the ITG harness. The legacy RWB-E2-010 AC1 to AC8 are owned by the app stories of the split, RWB-P1-E2010-APP first, and are cited here only through their `-ITG` test cases. The dated DP04 copies of treatment and claim are rwb-source-data's, built by Stage2ProductWorkflow, and the live claim record is rwb-guarantee's. Until the claim stories of wave 3 land, the claim read answers an empty list from the published fake, so the dp_guarantee_claim part of DP04 stays empty rather than stale in wave 2; this is recorded as a dependency of the DP04 release note. The case-existence answer for a claim is owned by RWB-P1-E2010-APP: this harness reads each claim with its case_id and resolves no case itself, and the References check, the break list and the retry stay with RWB-P1-E2010-APP.

edits.old: The treatment and guarantee_claim fields are read through the rwb-treatment and rwb-guarantee contracts, not from their tables.
edits.new: The treatment and guarantee_claim fields are read through the rwb-treatment and rwb-guarantee contracts, not from their tables. The live treatment row is held only by rwb-treatment in schema rwb_treatment; the dated dp_treatment copy belongs to RWB-P1-E2010-APP and is read for reporting only, never as the source of a treatment.

edits.new: 3. Harness: observes the stage 2 step of JOB-02 for 2026-12-14, started by the AceDataReady event of the day, and records the step state, its start and end, and the business date it built. The step is the workflow Stage2ProductWorkflow on queue rwb-source-data in namespace rwb-recovery, with the activities snapshot(page), writeDp04Page, checkActiveCount and stampDp04, started by rwb.source-data.AceDataReady.v1. The DP04 expected-by time is 08:00, as decision log DL11 assumed, until the data steward records the value in the data_product row.
